limitations: The gate is a bounded in-process control-plane contract and does not itself persist to a database or replicate memory across nodes.
Source identity, digests, trust, and verification receipts are caller-supplied; external signatures and hardware attestation are outside this implementation.
Quarantine preserves evidence metadata but does not inspect natural-language content for every possible injection pattern; upstream observation and tool validators remain required.
Promotion requires an explicit verification receipt and caller policy but does not itself establish human identity or execute high-impact actions.
The benchmark measures local Python control-plane overhead and excludes storage, network, model, accelerator, and kernel latency.
This evidence does not claim AGI, production approval, physical hardware qualification, independent builder qualification, or independent external review.
